item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Pork tenderloin stew with sausages, bacon and mushrooms. Served with creamy mashed potatoes and pickles.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: General Tao chicken with rice, baby corn and bell pepper. Served with fresh coleslaw. GREEN DISH: Dish General Tao tofu with rice, baby corn and bell pepper. Served with fresh coleslaw.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Noodles with crispy soy-marinated pork, pak choy, fried egg, sesame and chilli. (1+2+7+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Noodles with crispy soy-marinated tofu, pak choy, fried egg, sesame and chilli. (1+2+7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Boller i karry, classic Danish comfort food. Pork meatballs in an aromatic yellow curry sauce cooked with plenty of vegetables and apple. Served with rice and a herb salad with toasted coconut flakes and dried cranberries. GREEN DISH: Dish Chickpeas and vegetables in an aromatic yellow curry sauce cooked with plenty of vegetables and apple. Served with rice and a herb salad with toasted coconut flakes and dried cranberries.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Chicken in green curry tossed with Thai basil and lime leaves, served with fluffy jasmine rice and topped with spring onions. Served with lime, chilli oil, coriander and a fresh Asian coleslaw. (7+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pea protein in green curry tossed with Thai basil and lime leaves, served with fluffy jasmine rice and topped with spring onions. Served with lime, chilli oil, coriander and a fresh Asian coleslaw. The dish is vegan. (7+15)
